display.title: The Young Rebbe Maharash and Mishenichnas Adar (Fragment)
display.summary_short: A short informal Yiddish recording of the witty saying of the young Rebbe Maharash about 'when Adar comes in', followed by private conversation.
display.summary_long: Told in Yiddish, apparently recorded informally. The speaker retells a short anecdote about the Rebbe Maharash as a lively young boy: when his father, the Tzemach Tzedek, came into the room to check on him, he played on the words 'Mishenichnas Adar', when Adar comes in, joy increases, with a pun on 'Adar' and 'the father'. The recording is only about a minute and a half long, the transcript is partly garbled, and after the anecdote the speakers move on to private family conversation and good wishes.
